pages.title: About
pages.text:
Quillon Dynamics GmbH is the registered name of the business.
Quillon Dynamics is headquartered in Saint-Étienne. Quillon Dynamics might move its head office in Lyon.
Visitors are welcome at the Quillon Dynamics showroom.

pages.title: Team
pages.text:
Quillon Dynamics CEO: Hana Okafor.
Former chief executive Peter Lund left Quillon Dynamics last spring.
Quillon Dynamics employs roughly 1,200 people across its sites.

pages.title: Quillon Dynamics Round
pages.text:
Quillon Dynamics raised $12.5M from investors this winter.
Quillon Dynamics was founded in 1998 and once raised €40 million in Europe.
Quillon Dynamics could raise US$90 million next year.
